name: cloud9
description: Cloud9 Cloud9 is a collection of tools that you can use to code, build, run, test, debug, and release software in the cloud.

subcommands.name: create-environment-ec2
subcommands.description: Creates an Cloud9 development environment, launches an Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance, and then connects from the instance to the environment.

subcommands.name: create-environment-membership
subcommands.description: Adds an environment member to an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: delete-environment-membership
subcommands.description: Deletes an environment member from a development environment.

subcommands.name: describe-environment-memberships
subcommands.description: Gets information about environment members for an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: describe-environment-status
subcommands.description: Gets status information for an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: describe-environments
subcommands.description: Gets information about Cloud9 development environments.

subcommands.name: list-environments
subcommands.description: Gets a list of Cloud9 development environment identifiers.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the tags associated with an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: update-environment
subcommands.description: Changes the settings of an existing Cloud9 development environment.

subcommands.name: update-environment-membership
subcommands.description: Changes the settings of an existing environment member for an Cloud9 development environment.
